evals.prompt: I need to update existing products in ShopSite by SKU, but I do not want to create any brand-new records. Our CGI path is https://store.example.com/cgi-bin/merchant. Can you show me the documented dbupload.cgi parameters and a safe example request?
evals.expected_output: Grounded upload guidance with dbname=products, uniqueName=SKU, newRecords=no, a warning that unmatched rows will be ignored, and a reminder to publish after import.

evals.prompt: We have about 25,000 products to import into ShopSite and the last upload timed out halfway through. What is the safest documented batch strategy, and how would I resume if it stalls again?
evals.expected_output: A batching plan that recommends splitting uploads, using defer_linking=yes on interim batches, treating checkpoint as version-variable (older doc capture), using use_optimizer/batchsize per the official MIME example, mentioning restart=1 or Continue Upload when relevant, and reminding the user to finish linking/publish.

evals.prompt: Can you give me the full official XML schema for ShopSite pages so I can build a pages upload from scratch?
evals.expected_output: A refusal to invent the page XML schema, a clear statement that the crawlable docs do not publish a full official page XML example, and a recommendation to export a ShopSite-generated sample as the authoritative template.
